Preview digests, signed candidates, approval or revoke/configuration replay must be tied to that actual cut and original results; a Service transport response never proves creation/admission.

Provider identity and accepted room/recipient routing must gate the native notification effect; HTTP acceptance cannot be relabeled delivery.
Authorized room/blob binding, provider identity and media privacy/classification policy must gate download; an arbitrary URL or opaque success is insufficient.
Provider-scoped full-body hash must atomically bind the service-authored Event and Commit with exact replay and conflicting-body refusal.
Provider authentication and holder-private consent-contact admission/quarantine must not become a public permission oracle.
Verified RFC 9420 group identity, accepted room binding, provider role and original producer authority precede Event construction; observers must have zero effects.
Original holder-signed complete replacement, private exact-peer correlation, PCR authority and prior-current CAS are required.
Provider-bound accepted room identity and the actual native governance/producer permission gate are needed before any room update.
Native destination claim CAS and original signed claim outcome are required; Provider-ID, source and destination service binding cannot be replaced by a key-array stub.
Provider-scoped identifier correlation must be bound to accepted actor/room identity and anti-enumeration policy.

Provision, activate, presentation and status share immutable back-binding and one-use/replay state; neither a client-computed digest nor an unrelated Event signature authorizes it.

Requires the Account Authority issuer's original contiguous signed sequence and exact existing receiver/account relationship. Submit needs atomic monotonic replica and physical-erasure-intent acceptance; resolve needs original authorized ledger range. Current fixture has neither issuer history nor receiver replica, so no valid original request/response is claimed.

Existing client Contact views do not contain the five original holder-signed exchange facts, independently verified producer closures, per-round glare choice or source-confirmed effects. A positive peer submit requires both exact counterpart identities and durable native current/replay lineage; a client projection is not an accepted Contact exchange.

Requires an actually completed native deletion and original signed receipt plus retained stub bound to its exact accepted Event or AccountStatusRecord trigger. Submit must replay the same acceptance without triggering deletion; get needs original retained bytes and auditor authority. None can be reconstructed from current fixture values.

Requires real receiver admission/replication authority and branch-specific producer closures, exact inner-unit replay fences and accepted original Commit provenance. Existing scan history is source material only and cannot prove authorized receiver first admission, registered atomic materialization or zero-write conflicting replay.

Requires authenticated source/destination Stations, original Invite to the complete recipient Account and introduction evidence evaluated by the recipient's actual receive policy. The UI invite fixture does not establish recipient Station acceptance or its private delivery transaction.

Requires the destination authority's actual KeyPackage inventory/claim ledger, exact endpoint authorization and original claim receipt. Claim/consume/revoke are atomic transitions; query replays the original signed outcome without reconstructing keys or changing state.

Requires the destination Station's own current accepted Contact or joined-Realm relationship, purpose gate, target device material and original key attestation. Foreign user credentials must never be forwarded. Existing local device fixture cannot prove destination authorization, omission privacy or final delivery fences.

Requires the real accepted MLS Genesis and Commit Add, exact original recipient KeyPackage claim/Welcome and a recipient-Station-produced durable attestation. The actual outbox acknowledgement and governor installation, full independent histories, consumed Add provenance, recipient durable state and exact peer replay must all be retained; a scenario-created attestation or ACK alone earns no credit.

Requires eligible immutable genesis purpose, both old and new governance authorities, complete imported snapshot/stream heads and original dual-signed handoff transaction. Human and user-managed Agent PCRs must reject before any effects. A public bundle or standalone DID is not handoff permission.

Requires independently authenticated source/destination Stations and the current governor's accepted exact invite/audience or current member opening Commit. Preview must implement private non-enumeration and policy; bootstrap must bind original qualified signed snapshot/history and fresh nonce. Self UI join preview is a separate carrier and not proof of these peer contracts.

Requires independently authenticated source/destination Stations and the current governor's accepted exact invite/audience or current member opening Commit. Preview must implement private non-enumeration and policy; bootstrap must bind original qualified signed snapshot/history and fresh nonce. Self UI join preview is a separate carrier and not proof of these peer contracts.

Requires the native transient encrypted rail's actual source identity, destination/current scope authorization and forwarding behavior. No Event or Commit may be created and HTTP acceptance is not delivery proof. Existing self Signal mock does not exercise the service-authenticated peer relay or its zero-durable-effect gate.

The UI continuation handle map is not a validated native cursor authority instance. Requires exact Account/device/issuing-session identity, immutable token instance/expiry and durable scope-revocation horizon. Same device must not be treated as same session.

Requires a registered allowed kind, actual signing actor at its owning Station, exact Event signature and kind-specific target state. Value projection and canonical exact-retry outcome must commit atomically with revision/terminal conflict zero-write guarantees. AccountData and ReadCursor fixtures are dedicated contracts and cannot stand in for this native private-effect transaction.

Requires a real issuing grant and authenticated single-blob read capability envelope, TTL/scope binding and explicit plaintext classification. Current Blob bytes/HEAD fixtures contain no presign issuer or grant ledger; inventing a URL cannot test signature/integrity or encrypted-Blob refusal.

Requires the Realm-authorized media issuer and backend-specific expiring token with exact participant binding. Neither the ordinary Station key nor the ICE fixture is authority to mint a backend join token.

Normative operation notes explicitly forbid acknowledging rotation without the MLS genesis/commit/welcome cascade actually changing the cryptographic scope. No rotation fixture is wired; an empty success would be false.

Needs holder PCR root-control authority and exact peer CAS/current observation, or the owning-Station quarantine/effect transaction. Human and user-managed Agent separated-governor proxy/publication are prohibited; Organization-only proxy requires verified provenance. Contact state or public scope lookup cannot substitute.
